name: bricks/get-page-elements
label: Get page elements
description: Full element data for a page/template with all settings. Optionally filter to a specific element and its children.

postId.description: Post, page, or template ID. The primary identifier; prefer this whenever it is known.

path.description: Hierarchical path like "parent/child". Alternative to postId for nested pages.

title.description: Exact post title. Alternative to `postId`; ambiguous when multiple posts share the same title.

elementId.description: Optional: return only this element and its children.

maxDepth.description: Optional descendant depth to include. 0 returns only the root element(s), 1 includes direct children, and so on.

includeSettings.description: Whether to include full settings on returned elements. Defaults to true.

responseFormat.description: Use `summary` after broad writes to verify element counts, hierarchy, headings, global-class references, and SVG Image fallback sizing contracts without returning the full settings payload. Default `detailed` preserves the full element response.

returnFields.description: Optional list of element fields to return. `id` is always included. Defaults to all fields.

summary.description: Compact structural and reference-integrity verification when responseFormat is summary.

documentDigest.description: SHA-256 digest of the complete current Bricks element tree. Use as expectedDocumentDigest for optimistic-concurrency writes and import previews.
